name: Burn Edge
desc: The scene is printed on paper and the paper is burning — a ragged char front creeps in from the ignition point at x/y, an ember line licks and shimmers along its whole length, scorch browns the sheet just beyond it and ash lifts off ember-hot and tumbles up going grey; put the ignition off-frame for a classic edge burn or at 0.5/0.5 to eat it from the middle.

energy.doc: how far the burn has eaten in + ember heat

scale.doc: burn radius + ash size vs design size

alpha.doc: overlay opacity — high by default because char is meant to occlude

hue.doc: fire hue (22 orange, 8 deep red, 190 cold/chemical burn)

x.doc: ignition X — outside 0..1 puts the seat of the fire off-frame for an edge burn

y.doc: ignition Y — 1.02 burns up from the bottom, -0.02 burns down from the top

style.doc: aesthetic: warm-black charred paper with curl highlights / no solid char, a glowing additive ember net burning through / sepia nitrate stock blistering with melt-through holes / thermal isotherm schematic, hard contour rings and no char at all

act.doc: dramaturgy: the front breathes in and out, holding the frame / eats the whole frame over about 74s then a fresh sheet starts / the fire is fanned by the musical arc, flaring at peaks

seed.doc: char mottle + front raggedness + ash layout
